note: CPU-SECONDS ARE NOT PORTABLE ACROSS HOSTS. The repo rule -- a duration is meaningless without its host -- is stated about WALL time only; it is equally true of CPU time and nobody had checked. Every gate/ci row in docs/timings.md: make gate burns 6945-12090 CPU-s on lefford (40 cores) vs 2485-3873 on the 10-12 core Macs, i.e. 2-3x the CPU for the SAME suite, because lefford cores are individually much slower. Core count buys throughput, never latency. Best-case wall is 243 s there vs 322 s here. I projected a 3x gate speedup by dividing one hosts CPU-seconds by another hosts core count; it was wrong by ~10x. Read a recorded row, never project across hosts from arithmetic.
